siting._docMinSpacing: T4.1b/ADR-018: 95.2 km, DERIVED as s = r*sqrt(pi/0.866) = 50 * 1.9046 — the spacing at which a settlement's hex allotment EQUALS the catchment area it actually works. Was 480.0 (T3.2b re-denomination of minSpacingTravel = 30 cost units), at which 96 % of a settlement's allotment was never touched. SPACING IS A FLOOR, NOT A TARGET: founding still places settlementCount settlements; what this raises is CAPACITY (median 457 across 5 seeds), which colonization grows into over 6,000 years. Do not read 95.2 as a claim about how many villages a neolithic continent held.
